description: Inspect custom tables in one or more data models and flag the use of UNION.

datamodels.description: One or more data model references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a Sisense data model ID, or - a data model title (name). At least one data model reference is required. At runtime this method is tolerant of a single string being passed instead of a list, and will normalize it to a one-element list.

examples.user_query: Check if any custom tables in the 'Sales Analytics' data model use UNION.
examples.notes: This call analyzes the 'Sales Analytics' data model by title and flags any custom tables that use UNION in their SQL expressions.

examples.user_query: Inspect the custom tables in multiple data models, including 'Marketing Insights' and '12345'.
examples.notes: This call checks both a data model by title ('Marketing Insights') and another by ID ('12345') for UNION usage in their custom tables.

examples.user_query: Analyze the custom tables in the data model with ID '67890' to ensure no UNION is used.
examples.notes: This call inspects the data model identified by ID '67890' and flags any custom tables containing UNION in their SQL expressions.
